title: Agent Slayer retry descriptor
description: The authoritative version 1 contract for machine-readable retry guidance returned by a native tool or MCP provider. A valid descriptor describes whether and how a retry is technically possible; it does not authorize the retry.

retryable.description: True only when the owning tool or provider says another attempt can be valid after all reported conditions are satisfied. This field does not authorize or automatically schedule another attempt.

reason_code.description: A stable machine-readable code supplied by the owning tool or provider. Unknown codes may be recorded and shown but must not be assigned inferred workflow semantics.

requires_new_client_request_id.description: False means a retry remains the same logical provider operation and must reuse its existing provider-defined client request or idempotency ID when one exists. True means the owning provider requires the retry to be a new logical provider operation and the old provider-defined ID must not be reused. This never refers to an Agent Slayer request ID, interaction ID, model tool-call ID, receipt ID, plan ID, or other correlation ID.

preserve_complete_original_batch.description: True means retry arguments must preserve and resubmit the complete original batch plus valid corrections rather than only failed, missing, or changed items.

retry_after_ms.description: The minimum provider-directed delay in milliseconds measured from the recorded result time, or null when the provider specifies no delay.
